definitions.explanation: An aromatic herb (Artemisia indica) that grows wild throughout Japan. Used in cooking, traditional medicine, and cultural practices.

examples.japanese: ヨモギ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ヨモギ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道端|みちばた}→道端：28126_michibata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|は}えて→生える：02392_haeru⟧くる。
examples.english: When spring comes, mugwort grows along the roadsides.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{摘|つ}み→摘む：02472_tsumu⟧たて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ヨモギ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{草餅|くさもち}→草餅：15810_kusamochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother made grass mochi for me with freshly picked mugwort.

notes:
USAGE:
A versatile plant deeply connected to Japanese food culture. Most commonly used in ⟦{草餅|くさもち}→草餅：15810_kusamochi⟧ (grass mochi) and ヨモギ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧ (mugwort mochi), which have a distinctive green color and herbal aroma. Also used in ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧, tea, and traditional moxibustion therapy ({灸|きゅう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ヨモギ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧ (mugwort mochi)
- ⟦{草餅|くさもち}→草餅：15810_kusamochi⟧ (grass mochi — made with mugwort)
- ヨモギ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (mugwort tea)
- ヨモギ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摘|つ}む→摘む：02472_tsumu⟧ (pick mugwort)
- ヨモギ⟦{蒸|む}し→蒸し：14266_mushi⟧ (mugwort steam — a spa treatment)

WRITING:
Usually written in katakana. The kanji {蓬|よもぎ} exists but is uncommon in everyday use.
